entries.title: A Functional Analysis on Isolated Rat Islets of Langerhans: Effects of Dimethylsulfoxide and Low-Temperature Preservation

protocolSteps.summary: Rat islets were equilibrated in Me2SO before freezing in programmable or nested-beaker systems.
Samples were seeded near -6 °C and cooled to -75 °C at multiple controlled rates.
Frozen rat islets were held at terminal subzero temperatures before thaw and functional comparison.
Post-thaw rat islet function was compared across Me2SO concentrations and cooling systems.

outcomeMentions.summary: The study compared post-thaw functional performance of rat islets across Me2SO loading and cooling conditions.

entries.notes: Programmable-freezer DMSO study on isolated rat islets with controlled cooling and warming.

entries.title: Acellular matrix derived from rat liver improves the functionality of rat pancreatic islets before or after vitrification

protocolSteps.summary: Rat pancreatic islets were prepared with vitrification-compatible CPA conditions before matrix-supported preservation.
Islets were vitrified before or after seeding onto acellular liver-derived matrix.
Vitrified islets were rewarmed for functional comparison with non-matrix controls.
Post-warming islet functionality was compared with and without acellular liver matrix support.

outcomeMentions.summary: Acellular liver matrix improved the functionality of rat pancreatic islets before or after vitrification.

entries.notes: Primary rat islet vitrification study with an acellular liver-matrix intervention and functional readouts.

entries.title: Beraprost Sodium Improves Islet Yield and Viability in Canine Islet Cryopreservation

protocolSteps.summary: Cultured canine islets were pre-exposed to DMSO with beraprost sodium before cryounit freezing.
Canine islets were frozen in an automated cryounit under DMSO plus beraprost sodium conditions.
Frozen canine islets were stored in liquid nitrogen for one month.
Yield and viability were compared across beraprost sodium concentrations after cryopreservation.

outcomeMentions.summary: Beraprost sodium improved viability of cryopreserved canine islets.

entries.notes: Automated freezing study on canine pancreatic islets assessing beraprost sodium effects on yield and viability.

protocolSteps.summary: Rat islets were exposed at 0 °C to either 2.0 M DMSO or 2.0 M ethylene glycol before straw loading.

Frozen rat islets were stored in liquid nitrogen before thaw and in vitro comparison.
Toxicity and subsequent insulin-release behavior were compared after thawing.

entries.title: Direct comparison of Cryotop® vitriﬁcation and Bicell® freezing on recovery of functional rat pancreatic islets

protocolSteps.summary: Cryotop vitrification used EG/Me2SO equilibration followed by a higher-concentration vitrification solution with sucrose.
Comparator slow freezing used Bicell freezing with 15% Me2SO and controlled cooling before LN2 storage.
Cryotop and Bicell-preserved samples were transferred into liquid nitrogen storage.
Functional recovery of rat pancreatic islets was compared after Cryotop vitrification versus Bicell freezing.

outcomeMentions.summary: Functional recovery of rat pancreatic islets was compared directly between Cryotop vitrification and Bicell freezing.

entries.notes: Head-to-head rat islet study comparing Cryotop vitrification with Bicell freezing.

entries.title: Effect of thawing rate and post-thaw culture on the cryopreserved fetal rat islets: Functional and morphological correlation

protocolSteps.summary: Fetal rat islets were cooled in 2 M DMSO with ice nucleation at -8 °C and slow descent to -40 °C before liquid-nitrogen transfer.
Frozen fetal rat islets were rewarmed under fast and slow thawing conditions.
Post-thaw islets were cultured for 24 or 48 hours before comparison.
Functional and morphological outcomes were compared across thawing-rate and post-thaw culture conditions.

outcomeMentions.summary: The study compared post-thaw functional performance across thawing-rate and culture conditions.
The study reported morphological correlation after thawing and post-thaw culture.

entries.notes: Fetal rat islet cryopreservation study focused on thawing rate and post-thaw culture effects.

entries.title: Effects of Precryopreservation Culture on Survival of Rat Islets Transplanted after Slow Cooling and Rapid Thawing

protocolSteps.summary: Rat islets were step-loaded with Me2SO before controlled slow cooling.
Samples were seeded, cooled to -40 °C, and transferred to liquid nitrogen.
Frozen rat islets were stored in liquid nitrogen for 2 to 12 weeks.
Frozen rat islets were rapidly thawed in sucrose-containing medium before transplantation.
Post-thaw transplantation survival was compared after different precryopreservation culture conditions.

outcomeMentions.summary: The study compared transplantation survival after slow cooling and rapid thawing.

entries.notes: Primary rat islet survival/transplantation study assessing precryopreservation culture before slow cooling and rapid thawing.

entries.title: Human islet mass, morphology, and survival after cryopreservation using the Edmonton protocol

protocolSteps.summary: Human pancreatic islets were cryopreserved in 2 M DMSO and stored in liquid nitrogen.
Cryopreserved human islets were thawed into Edmonton or pre-Edmonton media.
Thawed human islets were maintained in post-thaw culture before comparison.
Post-thaw mass, morphology, and survival were measured under Edmonton-protocol conditions.

outcomeMentions.summary: The study measured post-thaw human islet morphology after Edmonton-protocol cryopreservation.
The study measured post-thaw human islet survival after cryopreservation.

entries.notes: Human islet cryopreservation evaluation study using the Edmonton protocol with post-thaw survival and morphology readouts.
